newsitem.title: JAPAN: JAPAN MACHINERY ORDERS ON SLOW RECOVERY TREND--EPA.
newsitem.headline: JAPAN MACHINERY ORDERS ON SLOW RECOVERY TREND--EPA.

text.p: Japan's machinery orders are on a slow recovery trend despite a fall in core private machinery orders in June, an official of the Economic Planning Agency (EPA) said on Friday.

The EPA earlier announced that Japan's private-sector machinery orders, excluding those for machinery at electric power firms and for ships, fell a seasonally adjusted 10.6 percent in June from the previous month.
"The June data does not imply that the economy is going to slow down in the future," the official told reporters.
The official said quarter-on-quarter comparisons of private machinery orders also indicated that the economy was not slowing down.
The EPA said it expected core private machinery orders to rise 2.2 percent in the July-September quarter from the previous quarter after an increase of 1.8 percent in the April-June period.
